description: Airport Slot Allocation is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Civil Aviation Authority. Database of the slots allocated to flights at UK airports, produced by ACL and licensed as a commercial product. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Civil Aviation Authority. The portal shows 2013-12-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
